featurePanels.title: Round 22 Wrap
items: Validated Round 22 card: 6 correct from 8 official NRL result lines.
Correct: Roosters over Cowboys, Dolphins over Dragons, Bulldogs over Storm, Panthers over Raiders, Sharks over Rabbitohs and Eels over Wests Tigers.
Missed: Titans over Warriors and Broncos over Knights.
The Roosters pick was a strong protect call, with Sydney winning 82-12.

featurePanels.title: What Hurt
items: The only planned controlled split failed: Warriors beat Titans 42-6.
Broncos were the bigger market-match miss, beaten 30-6 by Newcastle at Suncorp.
The safe market structure mostly worked, but P5 now requires sharper differentials rather than simply matching seven favourites.
Do not chase last week's misses emotionally; identify where leaders are likely to stay safe and split only where late mail supports it.

featurePanels.title: Next Strategy
items: Before Round 23, collect the fresh ladder screenshot and current market prices.
Build a leader-behaviour model: likely tips for the players from 1st to 4th, then Prince_of_Penrith action.
Use two controlled differentials if the gap to 2nd is meaningful; avoid more unless the ladder math demands it.
Keep charity bets separate from tipping-comp ladder aggression.

sections.title: Strategic Read
sections.heading: How to climb from P5
lines: Round 22's favourite-heavy approach landed six, but P5 now needs a little more upside.
For Round 23, start from the market favourites, then identify where the top-four tipsters are likely to copy each other.
Choose one or two differentials with clear injury, travel, venue or form support.
Avoid low-information punts: the Titans miss shows why splits need more than attacking upside.
Downgrade Brisbane until the Broncos show stability after the 30-6 Knights loss.
